agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario violates pole_upright due to sensor_noise 0.015 combined with coarse dt 0.015. Noisy angle measurement corrupts state-feedback controller; with no pushes and nominal plant, system is stable with zero noise but diverges when noise is present. Theta grows from ~-0.16 at step 20 to -0.20 at step 30 then to 0.44 at step 40, 0.71 at step 42, exceeding 0.8 at step 43 (0.86 rad) with high omega ~10 rad/s and cart speed ~8 m/s, while controller force (37-42 N) remains below limit but is ineffective due to noisy feedback. Counterfactual setting sensor_noise to 0 removes failure entirely.
